name: paraguay-social-contributions
description: Paraguay social security contributions to the Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS) for 2026: the general regime for employees (9% withheld from the worker, 16.5% employer as IPS collects it, of which 14% is the employer's IPS quota under Ley N° 98/1992, plus a 2.5% additional employer levy whose allocation is phased under Ley 7446/2024), what counts as salary for the base (overtime, commissions, bonuses, pay in kind; not the aguinaldo or the family allowance), the minimum-wage floor, domestic workers (Ley N° 5407/2015), part-time workers, voluntary affiliation at 13% (Ley N° 4933/2013), continuity contributions at 12.5%, teachers, ANDE staff and pensioners, the separate bank employees' fund (Caja Bancaria, 11% and 17%), monthly filing through the IPS REI system, and the fines of Ley N° 98/1992 and Ley N° 5655/2016. Trigger on: aportes IPS, aporte obrero patronal, IPS Paraguay, cuánto pago de IPS, seguro social Paraguay, trabajo doméstico IPS, IPS tiempo parcial, aporte voluntario IPS, C
